summaries.Romania: Romania won a historic legal victory against Gabriel Resources in the Roșia Montană case, avoiding €6.5 billion in damages and protecting environmental and UNESCO heritage. Political tensions escalated with unauthorized AUR protests supporting Călin Georgescu, while Dacian Cioloș gained international support for his bid to lead the Francophonie.
summaries.Healthcare: The Trump administration delayed enforcement of strict Medicaid work requirements for six months, while Democrats advance alternative Medicare expansion proposals; simultaneously, research into psychedelic treatments for PTSD and addiction is gaining government funding and clinical attention.
summaries.Tech: A massive Microsoft 365 outage paralyzed global communications for nearly 24 hours, while the FAA issued a rare nationwide ground stop over air traffic control communication failures; separately, Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia amid personal scandal raises questions about AI startup funding and semiconductor industry leadership.
